name: MARKED (Gun Testing)
desc:
MARKED, a criminal style shooter game! This game is just released for Gun Testing, meaning the game isn't fully done yet.

You choose a skin, and with that skin comes a firearm. You can buy Gamepasses with those skins aswell.

While this game is still trying to build itself up I would appreciate it very much if you guys would like the game and share it, to get the game up and going.

Other than that, join and have fun, and go mark others!
